snippet.title: Ajgal — Official Announcement Trailer | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Your daughter is gone. And now the world wants answers.

Ajgal is a psychological horror game where you play as Paul, a father descending into a decaying world shaped by guilt, ritual, and memory.

Explore haunting environments, solve symbolic puzzles, and face disturbing entities that echo your own failures.

“You were only absence. Now you are the offering.”

Coming soon. Add Ajgal to your Steam wishlist.
